[[File:Arkanian_Blinders.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Bao-Dur]] wearing Arkanian blinders]]
'''Arkanian blinders''' were a type of headgear developed by the [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanians]] to filter out infrared-light when traveling to [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] with suns that are high in such electro-magnetic energies. The Arkanian species was highly sensitive to IR light and thus needed technology to prevent 'ocular-overload'.
